queries.name: TaskPlanCorrectionPreview
rules: pure stable-snapshot query; missing Task/current plan or supplied Task/current-plan freshness mismatch returns TASK_NOT_FOUND or TASK_STALE rather than guessing a review context

fingerprint binds exact Task revision; current plan pointer revision/id and immutable interval/timezone/origin; the proposed replacement interval/timezone; explicit plan-lock presence/revision/value/last-event authority; execution current projection plus accepted non-correction-history count/current event authority; current outcome authority; applicable WFM source projection revision/lifecycle/base token/source-plan authority plus exact-current-source-revision terminal-review state vector; and applicable current Objective membership revision/pin/event, Objective revision/origin/supersession, envelope revision/fingerprint and aggregate revision/state/attention authority

fingerprint serialization uses strict canonical JSON under schema SOMA_TASK_PLAN_CORRECTION_REVIEW_V1 and lowercase SHA-256; row/UUID ordering is never chronology and only owner-defined semantic state enters the fingerprint

risk is HIGH iff current authority contains explicit_plan_lock=true, accepted non-correction Task execution history, current accepted Task outcome, current terminal WFM source history, or protected current Objective history; otherwise LOW
an exact-current-source-revision pending WFM source-terminal review appears as blocker SOURCE_TERMINAL_REVIEW_PENDING; the correction command may not override it
projection/current/history inconsistency produces no authorizing fingerprint and fails closed as TASK_PLAN_LOCKED
preview has no receipt, audit, domain revision, lock mutation, source-terminal review mutation, grouping proposal or external effect
